'''Skako''' was an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|core]] and homeworld to the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Though most of Skako was covered by urban sprawl, some examples of the planet's original ecosystem had been preserved in the form of vast fields of sprawling vines.

==Description==
The Skakoans rarely left the world due to their dependence on the [[Methane/Legends|methane]]-based atmosphere and heavy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressures. Establishing a major [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] comparable in terms of population and scale to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet-wide city lacked the Republic capital's charm and aesthetics.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In addition to the Skakoan people, the planet was also home to the [[Octuptarra/Legends|octuptarras]]— an eight-eyed creature with a gasbag-shaped head and multiple legs which inhabited the planet's vines.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The harsh environment on the planet ensured that the world was rarely visited and left in isolation, much to the contentment of the natives. Developing a religion based on the [[Book of the Boolmide]], the Skakoan people constructed a holy place called the [[Power Mounds of the Elders|Power Mounds]] from where the [[Elders (Skakoan)|Elders]] presided over the world's religious affairs.<ref name="WTAC" />

==History==
Skako was discovered during the blazing of the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

While Skakoans tended to stay out of galactic affairs, [[Core Campaigns|war]] was on their doorstep during the [[Second Alsakan Conflict]] which lasted from [[16,200 BBY]] until [[15,400 BBY]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Attaining membership in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], the Skakoans also had a leading interest within the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] by the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] which plagued the Republic in its final days. The Skakoan representative [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] led the Techno Union away from the Republic and to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], for which Skako was expelled from the Republic. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, Skako was a member world of the CIS, but was placed under the watchful eye of the [[1st Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. After Skako [[Capture of Skako/Legends|fell]] to the Republic and [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] Tambor was [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|murdered]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] with the rest of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], the Confederacy collapsed and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] replaced the Republic. Heralding a new era of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]], the Empire crushed the Techno Union and persecuted the Skakoans for their involvement in the war. Retreating to Skako to resume their isolationist stance, the Skakoans avoided the destruction of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by remaining distant from both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. By [[130 ABY]], Skako had been enveloped by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />
